name: three-phone
title: Three phones fanned out
description: Three tilted phones fan out on an arc from the centre one. Each screen is drawn in, or is your own image.

props.name: screens
props.doc: Left, centre and right screen. A built-in drawn screen (hero, dashboard, chart, plan) or a path to an image under public/, such as photos/nasa-earth-1.jpg.

props.name: font
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the type drawn on the built-in screens.

props.name: groundShade
props.doc: The ground at the lower right, away from the light.

props.name: fanAngle
props.doc: How far the outer phones turn in towards the centre one, in degrees.

props.name: spread
props.doc: Distance of the outer phones from the centre one, in pixels.

props.name: size
props.doc: Phone scale: 1 is 800 px tall at the wide shot.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Playback speed of the move: 2 is twice as fast.

props.name: startZoom
props.doc: How tight the camera is on the centre phone's screen at the start and on each screen it visits.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Film grain over the whole frame.
